We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied template 20810 to target, got two products: product1 = "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and product2 = "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". So first reaction splits target into those two fragments.

Now need to apply template 2895 to product1 (since we already checked it matches). Applying gave product: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". So second reaction transforms the aromatic amine to nitro? Actually adds nitro group.

Now we need to continue with templates 1914397, 1914398, 1914399, 74054 in order. Likely each applied to one of the fragments from previous steps, building a chain of 6 reactions total. We need to produce a JSON tree representing the route: root molecule target, child reaction 20810 with two children molecules (product1 and product2). Then product1 has child reaction 2895 leading to product1b (nitro). Then product1b undergoes reaction 1914397 etc. Also product2 may undergo some steps? The order must be as given, but not necessarily all on same branch? Probably sequentially on the main branch (product1). So we need to apply each template to the current molecule.

We need to apply template 1914397 to the nitro-containing molecule. Let's try.
